definition_en: a person who is trying to be elected or chosen for something
core_image: 站在台上等待点名的人
scene: 面试室外排着长队。Each candidate waited for the door to open.
sceneCN: 这里 candidate 是「候选人」（第 1 个义项：争取职位或被选中的人）；句意是每位候选人都等着门打开。

derivatives.zh: 坦率的，与 candidate 同源，本义为洁白的

senses.title: A person seeking election
senses.definition: a person competing for a post or office in an election
senses.definitionCN: 在选举中竞争职位的人
senses.why: The core image is a person standing forward to be named.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是一个人站到前面等待被点名。

senses.title: A person applying for a job
senses.definition: a person being considered for a job or place
senses.definitionCN: 被考虑录用或录取的人
senses.example: Each candidate waited for the door to open.
senses.exampleCN: 每位申请人都等着门打开。
senses.why: Being chosen for a job repeats the old idea of standing for selection.
senses.whyCN: 被挑选录用，沿用了站到前面等候挑选的旧意象。

senses.title: A person taking an exam
senses.definition: a person who sits an examination
senses.why: An exam is another selection, so the person examined is a candidate.
senses.whyCN: 考试也是一种挑选，所以应试者同样叫 candidate。

intro.en: Candidate comes from the white robe worn by Roman office seekers.
intro.cn: candidate 来自罗马竞选者所穿的白色长袍。

items.cn: 拉丁语 candidus 意为明亮的白色。

items.en: candidatus named a man dressed in white.
Roman seekers of office wore a white toga.
items.cn: 罗马求官者穿白色托加袍以示清白。

items.en: candidate named a person standing for office.
items.cn: 十七世纪英语 candidate 指竞选职位的人。

items.en: Candidate covers elections, job applications and exams.
items.cn: 现代英语中 candidate 兼指竞选者、求职者与考生。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the candid- base; the near-meaning group gives other contenders.
note.cn: 形近组共用 candid- 词基；近义组是其他竞争者。

entries.definition: the position of being a candidate
the state of standing as a candidate

entries.definitionCN: 坦率的，本义与洁白有关

entries.definition: a person who applies for something
a person formally proposed for a post
a person competing for a prize

normalIntro.en: Candidate began as a white-robed office seeker.
normalIntro.cn: candidate 最初指身穿白衣求官的人。

normal.en: A strong candidate has good chances.
normal.cn: strong candidate 指有力的竞争者。

normal.en: Interview a candidate is a common phrase.
normal.cn: interview a candidate 是常见说法。

normal.en: Candid shares the same Latin root.
normal.cn: candid 与它同源于拉丁语。

abstract.en: See a figure in white step onto a platform.
abstract.cn: 想象一个穿白衣的人走上台。

abstract.en: See a row of chairs outside a closed door.
abstract.cn: 想象关着的门外一排椅子。

abstract.en: See names listed on a board waiting to be chosen.
abstract.cn: 想象名单写在板上等人挑选。

examples.en: Each candidate waited for the door to open.
examples.cn: 每位申请人都等着门打开。

dict_mnemonic.text: candidate 里有 cand，像 candle 烛光，候选人举着烛火站在台上，等大家看清他再投票。

root: candidate 直接借自拉丁语 candidatus（穿白衣的人），词根 candidus 意为洁白；罗马求官者以白袍示清白，因此这个词转指候选人。

sensesIntro.en: A person seeking office, a person applying for work, and a person sitting an exam.
sensesIntro.cn: 竞选职位的人、求职的人，以及参加考试的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person in white standing forward to be chosen.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个穿白衣的人站到前面等待挑选。

intro.en: Candidate forms status nouns with -cy and -ure.
intro.cn: candidate 能加 -cy 与 -ure 构成表示身份的名词。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin candidatus, dressed in white.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是拉丁语 candidatus，意为穿白衣的。

items.meaning: the state of being a candidate
a person proposed for a post
